title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: PI Analyst (Inglês Avançado)
description:
Experienced Analyst(s)


a) Responsibilities:

i. Manage PI historians (access, new tags, security, interfaces).

ii. Manage AF SQL servers (access, security, create/edit new databases).

iii. Work with PI analysts to get workflow tags created on in-country PI historians for workflow output.

b) Required Skills:

Soft Skills needed:

Able to work in an Agile environment.

Demonstrate critical thinking, analytical skills, and employ judgment to offer thoughtful, concise input toward resolution of problems.

Able to translate data requirements into business processes and reverse engineer business processes into data requirements.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills with strong English proficiency.

Leadership skills needed to successfully promote ideas, coordinate work activities, and plan deliverables within a project team.

This is a hands-on technical role; the analyst should be able to work independently with the business and also in a team environment.

Technical Skills:

2+ years of demonstrated work experience supporting PI and/or PI AF.

Basic understanding of sensor data.

Knowledge and experience of working with the PI AF client.

Adding new databases, elements, creating/editing templates and analyses.

Add additional attributes, calculations, analyses as required from workflow groups and update global templates and existing AF databases (these are requested as the workflow is developed for the site).

SME for AF Builder tool – understand how it works, what is required and be able to teach PI analysts supporting in-country PI historians.

Understanding how PI tags are created and what info is required.

Understanding how PI databases work with each other.

Extensive interface skills especially using OPC UA/OPC DA/PItoPI/PI System Connector.

Properly designing and implementing interfaces that start up quickly and bring in high resolution data (sub-second data).

Interfaces are designed in such a way that troubleshooting can be quick and possibly automated.

Data Archive System skills.

Configuring systems with high tag count and high data resolution.

Expert in data manipulation tools such as: TOAD, Access, Excel.

Applications experience (e.g., VB Programming).

Intermediate to advanced SQL querying (SQL Server/Oracle etc.).

Comprehension of DevOps and Agile development and application to data centric architecture and solutions.

Practical skill sets in Data visualization tools.

Knowledge of other programming languages (as specified in an Order or communicated verbally by Buyer, as needed) and ability to write code.

title: Analista I de Desenvolvimento de Software | Ruby on Rails
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO :

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Ruby on Rails para integrar nosso time, focado em construir e manter soluções técnicas de alta qualidade. Se você gosta de trabalhar com metodologias ágeis e de criar aplicações escaláveis, essa oportunidade é para você.

Identificar não apenas o bug, mas sua causa raiz, propondo soluções eficazes para mitigar riscos.

  • Desenvolver e realizar a manutenção de aplicações utilizando o framework Ruby on Rails.
  • Criar, manter e evoluir APIs robustas, seguras e escaláveis.
  • Colaborar ativamente com a equipe na definição, desenho e implementação de soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Participar de ponta a ponta do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software, atuando em um ambiente colaborativo e orientado por metodologias ágeis.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Experiência prática e comprovada com desenvolvimento no framework Ruby on Rails.
  • Habilidade na construção, manutenção e consumo de APIs.
  • Vivência com modelagem e uso de bancos de dados não relacionais (NoSQL).
  • Experiência em versionamento de código utilizando Git.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER :

  • Experiência específica com MongoDB.
  • Conhecimento e prática em arquitetura REST.
  • Vivência ou familiaridade com arquitetura de Microsserviços.
  • Boa base em conceitos de arquitetura de software e vivência com frameworks ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica
state: estado do rio grande do norte

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack (JavaScript, React, Node.js)
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Typescript | React | Node


Modelo de contratação: PJ (sem benefícios)

Trabalho: 100% remoto

⏱ Dedicação: Fulltime


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

Frontend (React/Next.js)

  • Desenvolver interfaces dinâmicas com forte integração de APIs
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis utilizando hooks nativos do React (useState, useEffect, useContext, useCallback, useMemo)
  • Gerenciar estado global com Zustand
  • Trabalhar com TanStack Query para consumo eficiente de APIs
  • Utilizar shadcn/ui e Tailwind CSS para componentes


Backend (Node.js/Fastify)

  • Construir e manter APIs RESTful
  • Trabalhar com Drizzle ORM e PostgreSQL
  • Integrar serviços externos (Buckets, RabbitMQ)
Stack Tecnológica

Frontend

  • Next.js + React
  • TypeScript
  • Zustand (gerenciamento de estado)
  • TanStack Query
  • shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS


Backend

  • Node.js + TypeScript
  • Fastify
  • Drizzle ORM
  • PostgreSQL
  • RabbitMQ
  • Integração com Buckets/Storage
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript
  • Domínio de React (hooks, contexts, gerenciamento de estado)
  • Conhecimento em construção de APIs REST
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacional (PostgreSQL)
Diferenciais
  • Docker
  • Python (manipulação de arquivos)
  • Experiência com message brokers (RabbitMQ)


Maiores informações:

Desenvolvedor Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Sênior para atuar em um ambiente bancário robusto, de alta criticidade e grande impacto no negócio. Procuramos alguém que vá além do código: que entenda contexto, risco, performance e segurança — pilares essenciais do setor financeiro.


O desafio

Você fará parte de times estratégicos responsáveis por sistemas core do banco, com alto volume de transações, foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade técnica. Aqui, decisões técnicas realmente importam.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações Java de missão crítica
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Garantir performance, segurança e disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Trabalhar com integrações complexas (APIs, mensageria, sistemas legados)
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e decisões técnicas
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, arquitetura e segurança da informação


Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência com Java (21+)
  • Vivência comprovada no segmento bancário ou financeiro
  • Experiência com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em CI/CD, versionamento (Git) e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com sistemas de alta volumetria e baixa latência


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços em ambientes bancários
  • Conhecimentos em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)

  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Site Installation Engineer
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

In the role of Site Installation Engineer for Medium Gas Turbines (MGT) New Unit, you will work at a customer job site(s) you will be based in Brazil and will serve our global operations around the world. The position requires 80%+ travel to power plant sites internationally.

The Site Installation Engineer typically works in teams of two at the customer job site and owns the customer team by planning all installation activities related to the Gas Turbine scope of equipment. This means, among other things, advising job site logistics, plan the daily work, utilize technical drawings, participate in daily/weekly customer meetings, workforce planning and EHS governance for Siemens Energy related equipment. The Site Installation Engineer frequently interacts with the Siemens Energy project team in Sweden on progress reporting, technical support, and other relevant activities.


How You’ll Make an Impact 

  • The company’s face of the customer, while working on the customer job site.
  • Strive for a good customer relationship utilizing a positive and solution-oriented attitude.
  • Maintaining good progress in co-operation with both the customer team and Siemens Energy project team.
  • Reporting, keeping up to date documentations
  • Ensuring compliance with Siemens Energy procedures and EHS/Quality standards.


What You Bring 

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or related field.
  • Experience in installation of gas turbines.
  • Experience working in the field within industry with focus on mechanical and/or electrical work.
  • Strong collaborator with expertise in risk management and adaptability.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and quick to learn other software as needed.
  • Willing to travel domestically and internationally up to 80% and proficient in English (verbal and written).
  • Ability to lead, leadership skills. Experience from managing/leading small teams in an advantage,

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.


Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: 


Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.


Rewards/Benefits
  • Career growth and development opportunities
  • Supportive work culture
  • Company paid Health and wellness benefits
  • Paid Time Off and paid holidays
  • Profit Sharing Program
  • Private Pension
  • Parental leave

title: Email & Retention Marketer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,000 - $1,400 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a data-driven Part-Time Email Marketer  to own the end-to-end retention strategy for two sister companies: a visual, custom-framing e-commerce site and a B2B wholesale moulding supplier.


You will be responsible for turning one-time buyers into repeat customers (D2C) and nurturing long-term professional relationships with artists, photographers, and businesses (B2B).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lifecycle Strategy:  Audit and rebuild automated \"flows\" for both brands (Welcome Series, Abandoned Cart, Win-back, and Post-Purchase).
  • Segmentation:  Create distinct \"Pro\" vs. \"Consumer\" segments to ensure B2B leads (photographers/galleries) receive different messaging than one-off home decor customers.
  • Campaign Management:  Manage the weekly calendar for both brands, including promotional campaigns for the e-commerce brand and industry-specific insights and nurture content for the wholesale business.
  • A/B Testing:  Constantly experiment with subject lines, send times, and CTA layouts to optimize Open Rates and Click-Through Rates.
  • Performance Reporting:  Track and report on Email-Attributed Revenue and List Growth monthly.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Platform Expertise:  3+ years of advanced proficiency in e-commerce email marketing platforms is a must.
  • Copywriting:  Ability to toggle between \"Inspiring & Aesthetic\" (D2C) and \"Professional & Direct\" (B2B).
  • Design Lite:  Proficiency with visual design tools to create or edit email templates that align with the brand identity.
  • B2B Experience:  Experience with \"Sales Enablement\" style emails (plain-text, personal feel) meant to drive inquiries for high-volume wholesale orders.
  • Data Literacy:  Deep understanding of how to use email data to inform the wider growth strategy.


Bonus Points:

  • Experience in the home decor, photography, or art industries.
  • Understanding of SMS marketing integration.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to drive retention and growth strategies for a fast-evolving e-commerce and wholesale business.


Commitment: Part-Time (around 10-15 hours a week), Long-term, Overlapping with PST working hours.


*Please note our partner is only looking for dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Consultor(a) de Serviços
description:

No Electrolux Group, uma empresa líder global no segmento de eletrodomésticos, nós buscamos todos os dias transformar a vida para o melhor para os nossos consumidores, nossos colaboradores, e nosso planeta. Junte-se a nós na nossa incrível missão de construir a casa do futuro!


Tudo sobre a função:


Nossa ambição no Grupo Electrolux é liderar o aprimoramento da jornada do consumidor. Para manter um relacionamento significativo e mais direto, criamos a área de Consumer Direct Interaction, com uma estrutura completamente organizada e pensada para o consumidor, reunindo na mesma perspectiva as principais funções que compõem essa jornada. Dentro dessa área, nossas equipes de Consumer Care atuam de forma dinâmica e interpessoal para oferecer os melhores serviços de pós-vendas a nossos consumidores, entregando experiências extraordinárias para torná-los embaixadores leias de nossas marcas.


O que você vai fazer:


Como Consultor(a) de Serviços você será a referência da região, o embaixador da marca. Você irá prospectar e credenciar parceiros, manterá um relacionamento próximo e irá desenvolver a Rede de Serviços de sua região visando uma parceria “ganha-ganha”. Se você tem bom perfil proativo, ágil, comunicativo, organizado, criativo e inovador, aberto a novas ideias, com senso de prioridade, essa é a sua chance! Ajude a Electrolux a continuar transformando a vida para melhor, e nós te ajudaremos a voar ainda mais alto.


Algumas responsabilidades serão:

  • Alinhar as necessidades do negócio com as necessidades dos Serviços Autorizados, você precisará comunicar
  • Executar estratégias e ser um conselheiro do parceiro, sempre atento às necessidades e oportunidades da região.
  • Gestão dos KPIs de sua região e deverá manter padrão de qualidade de serviços.
  • Deverá ter um pensamento “Lean” sempre orientado à melhoria contínua, utilizando métodos aplicados de resolução de problemas e planos de ação.
  • Garantir a padronização da identidade visual na rede autorizada, sempre garantindo que os processos Electrolux sejam cumpridos pela Rede Autorizada Electrolux.



Como parte da cultura de melhoria contínua, você participará de projetos e atividades de Lean Thinking (EMS / EAI).


Quem você é


Você tem:

  • Curso superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Lean, Qualidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência da área de prestação de serviços e negociação com foco em pós-vendas;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Pacote Office;
  • CNH ativo e disponibilidade para viagens;


Onde vai estar


Você vai estar em Cuiabá e vai atuar em todo de Mato Grosso e Tocantins, podendo expandir futuramente para outros estados, com rotinas de viagens semanais conforme as prioridades necessárias.

Com o compromisso de criar uma cultura inclusiva e de cuidado com o bem-estar de todos, oferecemos os seguintes benefícios:

- Descontos nos produtos e serviços do Electrolux Group;

- Plano de saúde e seguro de vida;

Como parte do Electrolux Group, vamos investir continuamente em você e no seu desenvolvimento. Não existem barreiras para onde sua carreira pode te levar.

---------------

Por que trabalhar conosco?


Nós entendemos sua ambição e o Salem Advogados vai ao encontro dela. Você pode crescer muito mais em uma empresa em ascensão como a nossa!


Somos um grupo de empresas, com o Salem Advogados com marketing digital no mercado jurídico, expandimos para o Brasil inteiro.


Atualmente contamos com mais de 5.000 processos ativos em 14 áreas de atuação, realizando um atendimento de cerca de mais de 7.000 pessoas todos os meses por todo o Brasil.


Estamos acelerando a empresa e buscamos uma pessoa qualificada para nos ajudar a alcançar as metas.


Temos uma equipe de alta performance, e atualmente estamos com:

+5.000 processos ativos (fora os arquivados)

+85.000 novos leads por ano

+10 anos de experiência jurídica

+40 colaboradores na equipe


---------------

Detalhes sobre a vaga


  • Temos um software de CRM funil de vendas (Pipedrive) que permite registrar informações chave para facilitar criar o relacionamento
  • Já temos os leads gerados
  • O time comercial é estruturado em qualificador, fechador e pós-venda
  • Esta vaga é focada em vendas/fechador. Identificar as objeções e garantir o contrato.
  • Não gerará leads, não qualificará os leads, não fará pós-vendas depois de fechado o contrato
  • O foco é especializar para ganhar eficiência
  • No entanto, não temos cultura de braço curto. “Isso não faz parte da minha vaga” não existe aqui
  • Meta é inegociável, tem que ser batida


---------------

Candidato ideal


Há tipos diferentes de perfil de lead potencial, por isto é essencial que você tenha:

  • Capacidade analítica para entender qual lead fecha contrato e qual não fecha;
  • Capacidade analítica para entender o motivo do lead não ter fechado e ir participando da melhoria do script. Não basta apenas ligar usando o mesmo script sem entender o que está acontecendo
  • Capacidade de criar relatórios (o próprio software de vendas possui modelos prontos), com o objetivo de entender qual perfil fecha mais ou menos para focar no melhor perfil de cliente
  • Desenvolver relacionamento a fundo com clientes (rapport, aprender sobre o cliente)
  • Entender a necessidade do cliente e não apenas insistir na venda, mas construir relacionamento


---------------

Qualificações


  • 3+ anos de experiência em vendas
  • Excelente skill de comunicação
  • Habilidade de se auto-organizar e de priorização de trabalho (qual perfil de lead fecha mais e focar nestes)
  • Capacidade de analisar dados, fazer relatórios e tirar conclusões de métricas de vendas

  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

• Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collections issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to Controller for review and

payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in financial packages

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts,

graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their

technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income

statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End

Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to Staff Accountant


Requirements

  • 4+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S. GAAP
  • Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)
  • Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Accounting or Finance degree
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Can work US Timezone schedules 9am to 5pm EST


Compensation & Benefits

  • USD 3,000–3,500 per month , based on experience
  • Fully remote role with some flexibility included
  • Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes
  • Access to TGG University and learning resources
  • Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
  • PTO after onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.


We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Marketing Operations Manager (with Marketo)
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

We’re seeking a Marketing Operations Manager to own and evolve our Marketo ecosystem. This role will take full responsibility for the platform, improve how it’s structured and used, and partner closely with our Marketing team and Salesforce Admin to drive scalable, reliable execution. This person will immediately stabilize and improve the system, while enabling others on the team to operate more effectively.

We expect East/West Coast/etc. work hours.


As Our Marketing Operations Manager, You Will:

  • Own day-to-day execution in Marketo (email sends, landing pages, forms, smart campaigns, programs, UTM parameters)
  • Drive Marketo platform architecture, governance, and best practices
  • Improve program structure and operational standards
  • Design and maintain scalable campaign frameworks
  • Optimize lead lifecycle, scoring, routing, and sync with Salesforce
  • Act as the primary Marketo expert and point of escalation
  • Partner with the Salesforce Admin on data model, integrations, and automation
  • Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and technical debt
  • Support and mentor other Marketo users on the team
  • Contribute to longer-term marketing operations strategy and tooling decisions
  • Manage the integrations of additional tools like On24, ZoomInfo and other items in the MarTech stack
  • Maintain database health through smart list logic, segmentation, and deduplication strategies.
  • Track KPIs for campaign performance, conversion rates, and lead funnel progression.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to marketing automation workflows and program efficiency.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in a marketing operations or marketing automation role.
  • Proficient in Marketo ; Marketo Certified Expert (MCE) preferred. Hands-on, end-to-end usage as well as administrative support are equally critical. Experience with HubSpot is also preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM ; admin experience highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of marketing automation best practices including deliverability, nurture strategies, and lead scoring.
  • Experience with marketing data analysis, segmentation, and reporting.
  • Familiarity with UTM strategy, campaign attribution models, and web analytics tools.
  • Experience with integrations, webhooks, or APIs
  • Strong troubleshooting and systems-thinking skills
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, metrics-driven, and fast-paced team environment.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+/C1 or higher).


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes a competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Médico Especialista em Demência – Papel Consultivo (Dedicação Parcial)
description:
Sobre a Kuidar+

A Kuidar+ está desenvolvendo um modelo estruturado de coordenação de cuidados em demência , apoiado por tecnologia, para famílias que convivem com Alzheimer e outras demências no Brasil.

Nosso programa atua entre as consultas médicas , oferecendo monitoramento contínuo, suporte ao cuidador, coordenação de telemedicina e navegação estruturada do cuidado. A plataforma combina protocolos clínicos, ferramentas digitais, telemonitoramento e apoio baseado em inteligência artificial para ajudar famílias a lidar com os desafios médicos, comportamentais e práticos da demência.

O modelo é inspirado em iniciativas internacionais de coordenação de cuidado em demência, como o GUIDE Model (EUA) , adaptado ao contexto brasileiro.

Estamos atualmente em fase piloto , construindo o primeiro modelo operacional do programa e formando o primeiro Care Pod da Kuidar+.


Sobre a função

Buscamos um médico(a) com experiência em demência para atuar como Médico Advisor da Kuidar+ em regime de dedicação parcial.

Esta não é uma posição assistencial e não envolve consultas ou atendimento médico direto aos pacientes.


O papel combina dois objetivos principais:


Governança clínica

Apoiar a validação clínica do modelo de cuidado, garantindo que protocolos, critérios de triagem e fluxos de segurança estejam alinhados às melhores práticas no cuidado de pessoas com demência.


Desenvolvimento do modelo de cuidado

Contribuir para o desenho e evolução do modelo de coordenação de cuidados da Kuidar+, incluindo o uso de telemedicina, monitoramento remoto e ferramentas baseadas em inteligência artificial .

O profissional poderá ser apresentado publicamente como Clinical Advisor da Kuidar+ , contribuindo para a construção da arquitetura clínica do programa.

Com a evolução da empresa, poderá também participar de discussões estratégicas relacionadas ao desenvolvimento clínico da plataforma e do modelo de cuidado .


Responsabilidades

  • Revisar e validar protocolos clínicos utilizados no programa
  • Contribuir para a definição de critérios de triagem e escalonamento clínico
  • Oferecer orientação à equipe multidisciplinar em situações clínicas mais complexas
  • Participar de revisões periódicas de casos
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento do modelo de cuidado e das estruturas de segurança clínica


Dedicação

Aproximadamente 2–4 horas por semana , com atuação predominantemente remota.

A colaboração poderá iniciar em formato pontual por advisory , com possibilidade de evolução para retainer mensal conforme o programa se desenvolva.


Requisitos

  • Médico(a) com especialização em Geriatria, Neurologia ou área relacionada
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência clínica
  • Experiência no cuidado de pacientes com demência, Alzheimer ou transtornos cognitivos
  • Capacidade de colaborar em ambiente multidisciplinar
  • Conforto para comunicação em inglês


Por que esta posição é interessante

  • Participar da construção de um novo modelo de cuidado em demência no Brasil
  • Contribuir para protocolos clínicos que apoiam cuidado longitudinal fora do ambiente hospitalar
  • Trabalhar na interseção entre medicina, tecnologia, telemedicina e inteligência artificial
  • Colaborar com um time internacional e multidisciplinar

﻿

Resumo honesto

Estamos no começo.

O modelo ainda está sendo construído.

Esta não é uma posição clínica tradicional em hospital ou consultório. É uma oportunidade de participar da construção de um novo modelo de cuidado em demência , combinando prática clínica, tecnologia e coordenação estruturada do cuidado.

Se você tem experiência concreta na área e interesse em inovação em saúde, gostaríamos de conversar.

A Martz é um CRM omnichannel de retenção focado em e-commerce. Nossa plataforma centraliza dados de clientes, segmenta bases e ativa campanhas automáticas via WhatsApp, e-mail e SMS, tudo para aumentar a recompra, o LTV e o faturamento das lojas que confiam em nós.


Com 3 anos de mercado, temos centenas de lojas ativas na plataforma e seguimos crescendo. Somos uma empresa transparente, ágil e orientada a resultado, com integrações nativas com as principais plataformas de e-commerce e ERP do mercado, como Nuvemshop, Shopify, Tray, Bling e VTEX, atendendo tanto lojas virtuais quanto físicas.


Se você tem energia para construir relacionamentos, desenvolver parceiros e transformar conexões em resultados, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


• Gestão e relacionamento estratégico com agências e consultores parceiros da Martz;

• Capacitação e engajamento contínuo dos parceiros;

• Condução de apresentações, treinamentos e ações de relacionamento;

• Atuação junto às agências para resolução de cases, definição de estratégias e alinhamento com o cliente final;

• Planejamento e execução de ações para captação de indicações;

• Aquisição de novos parceiros.


Como será o seu dia a dia


• Gestão estratégica da carteira de parceiros, com foco em engajamento para indicações, reuniões estratégicas e follow-up;

• Atuação como referência técnica e comportamental, conduzindo treinamentos e apoiando o desenvolvimento das equipes parceiras;

• Garantia de alto padrão de excelência no uso da ferramenta e nas estratégias aplicadas;

• Organização junto ao financeiro e ao parceiro sobre pagamentos de comissão;

• Administração e otimização dos canais de comunicação interna (intranet, e-mails, WhatsApp, grupos e comunidade de parceiros);

• Monitoramento de indicadores de FUP e engajamento, organizando dados, insights e relatórios de apoio à tomada de decisão;

• Planejamento e execução de campanhas internas e ações de engajamento, do briefing à entrega;

• Apoio ao planejamento e execução de eventos como lives, jantares, ativações e encontros de parceiros;

• Contribuição ativa com ideias criativas e soluções inovadoras para fortalecer a cultura e os comportamentos do ecossistema de parceiros;

• Combinação de visão analítica, criatividade e forte capacidade de relacionamento para maximizar produtividade, rentabilidade e impulsionar o crescimento sustentável da operação.


Requisitos e Qualificações


• Ensino Médio Completo;

• Boa comunicação e capacidade de influência;

• Facilidade em aprender novas tecnologias e ferramentas de software;

• Perfil organizado, com visão estratégica e planejamento;

• Disponibilidade para viagens a eventos;

• Residência em São Paulo (capital ou Grande SP).


O que buscamos em você


Além das qualificações técnicas, queremos alguém com perfil consultivo, que saiba ouvir, construir confiança e movimentar pessoas em torno de um objetivo comum.


Local : Vaga Remota, mas residência em São Paulo (capital ou Grande SP) para participação em eventos.

title: SAP Basis Expert - Inglês Avançado
description:
Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas.


Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.


Buscamos um(a) SAP Basis Expert com sólida experiência em projetos complexos de upgrade, conversão e migração de ambientes SAP.


Você atuará em um contexto global , liderando execuções técnicas críticas, garantindo estabilidade, performance e evolução de ambientes SAP, colaborando com times multiculturais e clientes internacionais.



Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de upgrades, conversões, migrações e manutenções em ambientes SAP.
  • Planejar e executar estratégias completas de evolução de sistemas: análise de impacto, roadmap técnico, cronogramas e execução em ambientes Dev/QA/Prod.
  • Conduzir processos de system upgrade, system conversion, OS/DB migration, e HANA upgrades, assegurando conformidade com melhores práticas SAP.
  • Realizar cutover planning, coordenação de mock runs e atividades críticas de produção.
  • Diagnosticar incidentes complexos em ambientes SAP Basis, atuando na resolução de problemas e mitigação de riscos.
  • Garantir documentação completa dos processos técnicos, lições aprendidas e recomendações de melhoria contínua.
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais, arquitetos e stakeholders globais para assegurar compatibilidade e readiness das soluções.
  • Acompanhar o roadmap SAP, avaliando impactos e oportunidades de atualização para os ambientes dos clientes.



Requisitos:

  • 8+ anos de experiência comprovada em SAP Basis.
  • Domínio em:
  • SAP system upgrades (NetWeaver, EHP, SPS, Kernel)
  • SAP S/4HANA conversions (pré-checks, simplification item, custom code remediation)
  • System copies e client copies
  • OS/DB migrations e Unicode conversions
  • HANA database upgrades
  • Proficiência com ferramentas: SUM, DMO, Maintenance Planner, SPAM/SAINT.
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com equipes e clientes internacionais.
  • Experiência em ambientes globais ou operações Nearshore é um diferencial.



Diferenciais:

  • Certificações SAP Basis ou SAP HANA.
  • Experiência com ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Vivência com projetos multiculturais.



Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT

Modalidade: 100% Home office



Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.



*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Arquiteto de Soluções - Com Foco em IA
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


No Grupo Fleury , acreditamos que o futuro da saúde será cada vez mais data-driven, inteligente e digital. Estamos construindo um ecossistema tecnológico que integra dados, inteligência artificial, automação e plataformas digitais, com o objetivo de transformar a jornada de cuidado em saúde.

Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções, que será responsável por projetar e evoluir soluções tecnológicas escaláveis que utilizem IA, dados e plataformas cloud para gerar impacto real no negócio.


Se você é apaixonado por arquitetura de sistemas, IA generativa, plataformas de dados e cloud computing, essa oportunidade é para você.


Principais desafios da posição:


• Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial, incluindo aplicações de Machine Learning, IA Generativa e automação inteligente.

• Projetar arquiteturas modernas baseadas em cloud-native architecture, microservices e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

• Desenvolver soluções que integrem plataformas de dados, modelos de IA, APIs e sistemas corporativos.

• Atuar no desenho de soluções com Large Language Models (LLMs), GenAI, AI Agents e automação baseada em IA.

• Definir padrões de arquitetura para soluções que utilizem plataformas de IA em nuvem.

• Apoiar squads de engenharia no desenvolvimento de soluções com IA, dados e plataformas digitais.

• Garantir que as soluções atendam requisitos de segurança, governança de dados, escalabilidade e observabilidade.

• Avaliar novas tecnologias e frameworks emergentes no ecossistema de AI, Data e Cloud Architecture.


Tecnologias e plataformas com as quais você irá trabalhar:

A arquitetura da companhia envolve um ecossistema moderno de tecnologias, incluindo:

  • Cloud e Plataformas de IA
  • AWS (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, EKS, Aurora, API Gateway)
  • Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, AKS, Data Factory, Synapse)
  • Google Cloud Platform (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE)

Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning

  • LLMs e GenAI (OpenAI, Claude, Llama, Gemini)
  • Frameworks de IA (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face)
  • AI Agents e arquiteturas multi-agent
  • RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
  • MLOps e LLMOps

Arquitetura de Software e Integração

  • Microservices e APIs
  • Event-driven architecture
  • Kafka, RabbitMQ e streaming de dados
  • API Management

Engenharia e Plataforma

  • Kubernetes / OpenShift
  • CI/CD e DevOps
  • Observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible)


Buscamos profissionais com:


• Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções, Arquiteto de Software ou Arquiteto de Plataforma.

• Experiência em arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

• Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning ou IA Generativa.

• Experiência com arquitetura de dados, APIs e integração de sistemas.

• Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e cloud-native.

• Conhecimento em DevOps, CI/CD e observabilidade.

• Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Diferenciais importantes:


• Experiência com GenAI, AI Agents ou plataformas de IA corporativa.

• Experiência com arquitetura de dados e data platforms (Data Lake, Data Mesh ou Lakehouse).

• Experiência em ambientes regulados como healthcare, financeiro ou telecom.

• Participação em iniciativas de transformação digital baseada em IA.


Nosso jeito de trabalhar, buscamos pessoas que:

• Estimulem a troca de conhecimento e colaboração entre times.

• Invistam continuamente em aprendizado e evolução técnica.

• Conectem tecnologia e negócio para gerar impacto real.

• Busquem inovação contínua e melhoria das soluções.


Informações da vaga:


  • Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)
  • Carga Horária: 220h Mês - 44h Semanais
  • Escala: Segunda á sexta - feira.
  • Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:


• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:


• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:


• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

description:

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Us

We are an industry leader in providing technology solutions in Canada. We are one of the largest technology solutions providers, recognized for our ability to deliver and innovate to meet the changing needs of our clients. Our services include IT consulting, managed services, cloud solutions, infrastructure design and implementation, and software development. We take pride in our ability to provide comprehensive, customized solutions to meet the unique needs of each of our clients.


Position Overview

We currently looking for an Executive Assistant to be a supportive force who empowers our Executive Leadership Team. This role can be operated from fully remote capacity.

This role requires a self-starter with a sense of urgency, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver with exceptional communication skills and meticulous attention to details. This person should have experience working in an office environment, performing administrative duties, and providing support to executives. Given the dynamic nature of the executive landscape, we rely on executive assistants to be flexible and consistent while maintaining the confidentiality of high-level systems and our day-to-day operations. You will also assist in coordinating company’s leadership planning cadence, general administrative tasks, office management and support various organizational needs. We are looking for a “trusted partner” who can handle the daily challenges, streamline operations, and ensure the smooth functioning of the business.

The successful candidate will be extremely organized with outstanding attention to detail, time management, and professional communication skills. In addition, they will have solid overall business acumen, approach every task and challenge with energy and tenacity, and handle confidential information appropriately.


Responsibilities:

  • Schedule and manage meetings and other calendar events, including sending and accepting electronic invitations, as well as creating and distributing relevant materials in advance.
  • Plan and orchestrate work to ensure that senior executives’ priorities are met, organizational goals are achieved, and best practices are upheld.
  • Participate in team, management, and executive meetings, take and distribute minutes and action items, and follow up on their completion.
  • Coordinate complex scheduling and calendar management, as well as content and flow of information to senior executives.
  • Being the point of contact for general communications for the Executives they support
  • Assist in drafting and sending communications and correspondence.
  • Create, manage, and file monthly expenses.
  • Assist with travel arrangements and keep track of itineraries.
  • Complete reports and assist with special projects as requested.
  • Manage employee vacation calendars for supported teams.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations.
  • Participate in event planning.
  • Assist with general office management duties.
  • Provide additional support to executive team members, as directed, to ensure that company goals and objectives are accomplished and that operations run efficiently.
  • Support the coordination of personal calendars and activities as requested
  • Provide general administrative duties as requested


Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Education in business or related field is an asset
  • Minimum 3-4 years' experience in an administrative role reporting directly to upper management is preferred
  • Superb written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • Strong time-management skills and the ability to organize and coordinate multiple projects at once
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other office productivity tools, with aptitude to learn new software and systems
  • Flexible team player willing to do what it takes to get the job done; adaptable and enjoys a challenge
  • Event coordination experience is an asset

Additional Requirements

  • Must be able to work remotely in Pacific Time Zone – Vancouver, Canada
  • Comply with background check requirements
  • This position requires reliable internet connection, backup power, and the use of personal equipment such as Desktop/laptop, mouse keyboard, additional monitor screens and a headset

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**

Full-time position.

Pay is $8-$10 per hour paid in USD.


Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.


Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software

Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals


Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

  • Atuar diretamente nas corretoras, com foco na comercialização de seguros (Riscos patrimoniais e Transportes), sempre em alinhamento com as estratégias da Wiz, Pamcary e Mapfre;

  • Pacote Office;

  • Experiência na área Comercial / VENDAS;

title: Salesforce Business System Analyst
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)

Location: LATAM

Duration: 6-12months

Job Summary:

We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.

Key Responsibilities:

·Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.

·Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows .

·Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards .

·Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.

·Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.

·Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation .

·Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues.

·Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams .

·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization .

Required Qualifications:

·3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure .

·Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud .

·Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management .

·Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies .

·Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications .

·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration .

·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills
